rules.what: INT-DOT-VNNI, ONE ROW: 4 x VPDPBUSD + that row's lane total == sum_i u_i*x_i in index order (int32), and no int32 wrap (== the 48-bit sum) under DOM-ACT-Q; the red_quads / red_quad1 lane maps are the separate T lemmas of z3_int.py

INT-DOT-MADDUBS-Q4, ONE ROW: maddubs pairs, VPADDW low+high, madd(.,1), the row's lane total (red8's lane map: z3_int T lemma) == sum n_i x_i (no saturation, no VPADDW wrap, no int32 wrap) for n in [0,15], DOM-ACT-Q
INT-DOT-SIGNTRICK-Q8, ONE ROW: maddubs(PABSB(w), PSIGNB(x, w)), madd(.,1), the row's lane total (red8: z3_int T lemma) == sum w_i x_i for any w, under DOM-ACT-Q (x != -128); no saturation (32,512)
R14 without DOM-ACT-Q (expect a counterexample: x = -128, w < 0)
INT-BIAS-NIB: sum (n_i - 8) x_i == sum n_i x_i - 8*a.sum with a.sum = sum x_i (DOM-ACT-SUM), int32, and no int32 wrap
INT-BIAS-XOR80: sum q_i x_i == sum u8(q_i xor 0x80) x_i - 128*a.sum (DOM-ACT-SUM), int32, no wrap
INT-SUM-ACT: AVX2 (8 x VPADDD + hsum8_i32) and AVX-512 (4 x VPADDD + hsum_i32) == sequential sum, no int32 wrap, |q| <= 127
